title: Rep. Chip Roy Press Office urges congressional action after Supreme Court birthright citizenship ruling
text:
Rep. Chip Roy Press Office urges congressional action after Supreme Court birthright citizenship ruling
Rep. Chip Roy Press Office issued a series of statements on June 30, 2026, criticizing the Supreme Court's decision regarding birthright citizenship and urging Congress to take legislative action in response.
In a statement posted at 14:52 UTC, the office said, “The Supreme Court, led by Chief Justice Roberts, failed the American people, the Constitution, and the rule of law today—not to mention the national security of the”.
Later that day at 15:08 UTC, another post stated, "Today's Supreme Court decision on birthright citizenship is a REMINDER why Congress MUST codify permanent border security policies to stop illegal immigration that leads to automatic U.S. citizenship to the children of illegal aliens. Pass Rep. Roy’s Permanent Trump Secure".
At 15:24 UTC, Rep. Roy’s office added context about previous efforts related to this issue: "Back in January, Rep. Roy led an amicus brief with @SenEricSchmitt supporting President Trump’s Executive Order defending the original meaning of the Fourteenth Amendment’s Citizenship Clause. Today’s Supreme Court decision was a grave mistake. Congress must now act to fix this."
Chip Roy has served as U.S. Representative for Texas’ 21st District since 2019 after succeeding Lamar Smith and has won several general elections against Democratic challengers including Kristin Hook in 2024 (61.9% to 36.1%), Claudia Zapata in 2022 (62.8% to 37.2%), Wendy Davis in 2020 (52% to 45.4%), and Joseph Kopser in 2018 (50.2% to 47.6%).
